reasons.issue: Goalie-placement/zone defect: this defensive-zone-coverage scene (Navy covering Gold's far-side low slot in Navy's own end) was built entirely at positive x (actors from 20 to 23), which is Gold's defensive end under the fixed rule 'Navy attacks +x' (so Navy's own defended net sits at negative x, not positive x). Cross-checked against every other goalie-anchored scenario in bank-snapshot.json: home/Navy goalies sit at x=-26/-27 (exp26-u13-016, exp26-u13-018, exp26b-u13-019, exp26-u15-008, exp26-u15-011) and away/Gold goalies sit at x=+26/+27 (exp26-u13-010, exp26-u13-011, exp26b-u13-006, exp26b-u13-007) with zero exceptions outside this scenario's own numbered cluster (exp26b-u13-011 through -015). Sibling scenario exp26b-u13-014 makes the same defect explicit and unmistakable: it places an actual actor labeled 'Navy goalie' at x=27, directly contradicting the fixed rule and every other goalie in the bank.
reasons.change: Mirrored the scene across the centre line: negated every actor's x-coordinate and reflected each actor's facing (facing' = pi - facing, normalized to [0,2*pi)) so the whole picture now sits correctly in Navy's own defensive zone near x=-20 to -23. This preserves every relative distance, angle and facing relationship between actors exactly (a pure reflection), so no tactical relationship (who is between whom, who faces whom, who is closer) changes — only which physical end of the ice the scene occupies. The owned puck (Gold 1's carry) was recomputed from Gold 1's new position/facing using the app's own carried-puck formula (x=actor.x+cos(facing)-0.7*sin(facing), y=actor.y+sin(facing)+0.7*cos(facing)) rather than a naive coordinate negation, since that formula is not itself symmetric under simple negation. The q4 position-question reference point's x-coordinate was negated to match.
reasons.evidence: bank-snapshot.json goalie audit (see script output): 6 home/Navy goalies at x=-26/-27 with facing 0, 6+ away/Gold goalies at x=+26/+27 with facing~3.14, zero exceptions outside exp26b-u13-011..015. sourceChecks.scope: Fetched and read. It does not itself discuss defensive-zone coverage, weak-side/low-slot coverage or net-front/rebound roles. sourceChecks.scope: Fetched and read (Team Canada Program of Excellence U17 Technical Curriculum, (c) Hockey Canada 2008). PDF page 8 contains a 'Support - Defensive' section reading: 'The player defending against the puck carrier requires the support of teammates to ensure that they are active away from the puck carrier and position themselves in a manner that will eliminate the options of the puck carrier. Players must be able to read the offensive options available to the puck carrier and move to a position that minimizes or takes away these options.' This directly and genuinely supports the teaching point in both scenarios (a teammate away from the direct puck battle reading and covering the next-most-dangerous option). This is a U17/POE (national-team-track) source being adapted down to U13 house-league content, which is disclosed in the scenario's own 'use' field ('Supports the stated coaching principle... not source-certified') rather than presented as a U13-specific or rule-level citation.
